prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: art-direction research board for HealthGoals, NOT an app UI. Create a sophisticated landscape concept-art moodboard, high visual density yet excellent whitespace, no phone mockups, cards, dashboard, app screen, rings, gauges, mascots, athlete, badges, confetti, teal or cream. Spanish editorial labels, crisp typography. Illustrations and abstract sculptural data objects should occupy most of the board. A personal WEEKLY goal has three references: real amount now, habitual amount at this moment, final goal. No days or daily quotas. Use illustrative data only: REAL 24.000, HABITUAL 21.500, META 40.000, RESTAN 16.000. Label data studies as abstract research. Include clearly different color swatches, typography sample Aa 0123, simple line icons, shape vocabulary, material closeup, one small light/dark study, a short motion sequence of three frames and a tiny neutral native glass action floating beside opaque content as a conceptual iOS26 coexistence reference, not an app screen. Glass is only a control, never the brand or data material. All typography and art should feel adult, optimistic and contemporary. Direction A: PLEGAR. Adjectives: táctil, serena, escultórica, precisa. Opaque cobalt blue and burnt vermilion paper, optical white and deep navy backgrounds. Monumental asymmetric pleated paper planes and cut-paper contours, beautiful macro fold shadows, airy industrial still-life and architecture, extremely simple monoline icon samples, quietly geometric humanist sans and tabular figures. Data object studies have a colored actual opaque folded surface ending at 60%, a thin dashed independent habitual fold contour at53.75%, and an empty outer cut-pattern silhouette ending at100%; all share a direction/quantity scale but are NOT a rectangular bar or semicircle. Motion shown as purposeful crease advance between two known readings. No literal mountains, walking paths, timeline or folded daily segments. Build a genuinely sculptural material world, not a minimalist chart sheet. Title PLEGAR.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create a landscape visual exploration plate with THREE large distinct concept-art studies side by side, identified A01/A02/A03 or matching supplied IDs. This is rapid ART DIRECTION research for HealthGoals, NOT a screen or wireframe. Make each main object radically different in morphology and integration, not just three differently colored bars. No phones, no UI cards, no dashboard, no rectangular bars, no gauges/fans, no rings, no charts, no seven sections or daily markers, no paths from Gentler, no mascot, no teal/cream, no decorative separate illustration. Adult, contemporary, optimistic. Each concept must visibly distinguish THREE references sharing a calibrated amount scale: opaque SOLID REAL now 24.000 =60% of the weekly goal, independently DASHED or HOLLOW HABITUAL now 21.500 =53.75%, OPEN OUTER final META 40.000 =100%, visible remaining negative space RESTAN16.000. Amount, not time or distance. Colored actual and reference outline must not be stacked into a total or look like two independent goals. Label each object with short leader labels 'REAL 24.000', 'HABITUAL 21.500', 'META40.000', 'RESTAN16.000'. Include small supporting schematic at bottom of each concept with real BEFORE reference ('POR DEBAJO'), aligned ('A TU RITMO'), after ('POR DELANTE'), preserving identical color; these are abstract topology examples with no invented threshold policy. Main actual example is ahead geometrically. Exact numbers are labels, not proof of pixel precision. Pair actual progress and remaining visually within the artwork, not headline then chart then numbers. Below the three concepts add a very small repeated proof for 'ACTIVIDAD', real1200 expected1075 target2000 remaining800 kcal; same60/53.75/100 relation and separate units. Keep all art material opaque, glass absent. Excellent art-director taste and crisp restrained Spanish typography. Clearly mark 'ESTUDIOS CONCEPTUALES'. PLEGAR palette cobalt blue, burnt vermilion, optical white navy. Matte paper sculpture. A01 'PLIEGUE TESTIGO': a flared asymmetric origami plane whose real solid front edge goes just beyond the dashed habitual crease witness and occupies60% of its length, open wire-cut target pattern continuing to100%; same origin, reference stays visible above solid paper. A02 'ESTRATOS': a thick asymmetric stack of die-cut paper strata, solid current leading stratum distinct from thin unfilled habitual stratum and distant final outer silhouette; calibrated depth, avoid stairs signifying daily quota. A03 'VENTANA': a suspended irregular paper aperture, solid current reveal, fine independent habitual aperture inset, full goal opening. Each must look tactile and sculptural, not a landscape. Do not use fan geometry. Large objects, minimal annotation.
